subject: Locating a Codex CLI / control entry on Windows (read-only search)
method: Read-only lookups: PATH search, npm global package listing, Start Menu and per-user program directories, MSIX package inventory (winget list), and top-level directory-name listing of the user's .codex home. No file contents under the user's .codex home were read; no application was launched.

findings.startMenuAndProgramDirs: No codex-named entries in user or all-users Start Menu programs, nor in per-user LocalAppData Programs

msixInventory.note: This is the ChatGPT desktop application carrying the OpenAI.Codex package identity, not the codex CLI binary verified on macOS.

userCodexHome.inspection: Top-level directory names only (configuration and session-history files were NOT opened); names are consistent with prior Codex CLI/desktop use.

conclusion: No standalone codex CLI executable is located on this Windows machine by PATH, npm global, Start Menu, per-user program directories or MSIX inventory. The installed OpenAI surface is the ChatGPT desktop application (OpenAI.Codex MSIX 26.825.6671.0), and a user .codex home exists, so prior Codex use is likely, but the macOS-verified `codex app-server` stdio control surface is not established here. All Codex control capabilities remain unknown; this does not prove absence of other install channels.
